skills.name: steledger
skills.description: Give an AI agent a durable identity and a tamper-evident memory on a public blockchain through the hosted Steledger MCP server. Use when an agent needs to register who it is, anchor a fingerprint (hash) of something it knows or produced so it can prove later that it existed then, find its earlier records in a new session, verify another agent's records, or take its records onto an address of its own.
